name: Beach Lifeguard
steps: Drag lifebuoy to rescue drowning boy.
Pour ice bucket on sunburned man.
Drag tongs to pop fake shark fin.
Drag sunglasses to give kid shade.
Drag kid to cool cloud shadow spot.
Tap phone to call medical help.
Open first-aid kit to treat injuries.
Pour water on grill to stop fire.
Tap whistle to finish and restore safety.
